# Orienting

> Orienting is Ting Wang's independent advisory practice for businesses implementing eCommerce and AI regulatory requirements.

## Principal

Tzu-Ting Wang has 15+ years of experience across product, risk, compliance, finance, and advisory work. She spent 10 years at Amazon's European headquarters. She was one of three founding members of the team that built Amazon's European compliance program from the ground up; the model later became Amazon's global standard. In her final role, she advised Amazon's European board members on risk and governance strategy. She previously worked at Deloitte and KPMG.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/wangtzuting/
- Newsletter: https://twspace.substack.com/
- Events: https://luma.com/user/ttwang

## What Orienting helps with

- eCommerce and AI regulatory implementation
- Marketplace seller onboarding, verification, monitoring, and enforcement
- Operating models, clear ownership, escalation, and risk governance
